summary: Replace persona-first prompting with measured behavior contracts, using roles only where comparative evaluation shows value.

items.text: Define a professional behavior contract: audience, decision standard, evidence hierarchy, required checks, uncertainty vocabulary, refusal boundary, and output schema.
A/B test neutral, role-framed, and behavior-contract prompts on a versioned task suite, scoring correctness and calibration as well as style.
Require claim-level evidence labels such as sourced, computed, inferred, assumed, or unknown, and prohibit professional tone from changing those labels.
Select framing by task and observed model performance rather than applying one expert persona across the system.
